articles.deck: Residents of Canal Park filled the hall on Tuesday to ask questions about the plan.

articles.title: Canal Park Elementary Adds Street Tree Planting to Spring Schedule
articles.deck: The program begins in March and is open to all students in grade 6 and up.
body: The board will review the results at the end of the spring term. Sign-up forms went home in backpacks this week, and the first session is set for March.

Students will meet on Saturday afternoons in the Hickory Ridge rec center, and transportation will be provided for those who need it. Principal Gwen Nakamura said the program was built with help from parents and local volunteers.

articles.title: Arthur Sandoval, 68, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Arthur Sandoval for the many years of service to Mill Hill.
body: Born in Mill Hill in the years after the war, Arthur Sandoval spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Mill Hill. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to St. Brendan’s Parish in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Millrace Youth Center
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Mulberry Avenue for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Youth Center has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the December meeting.
Sergio Kessler, Bellwood

articles.title: Then & Now: Pine Court in 1984 and Today
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1984 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Pine Court from the corner of Beacon Place.

Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal. Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.
